verdict_rationale: Empirical audit proves that raw spatial NWP data (AROME-Arctic 2.5km and MEPS 2.5km) for the Day D-1 18:00 UTC run are published on MET Norway THREDDS by ~20:15-20:45 UTC Day D-1, preceding the locked benchmark origin t0 = 00:00 UTC Day D by 3.25 to 3.75 hours. Forecast leads +6h to +29h cover all 24 POLARIS horizons (H1-H24) without post-t0 data leakage.

arome_arctic.operational_delay_risk: None. Even with +2h HPC delays (~22:30 UTC), data is available before t0 (00:00 UTC)
arome_arctic.polaris_lead_mapping: H1 (00:00 UTC) = Lead +6h through H24 (23:00 UTC) = Lead +29h

stage8_5.description: Stage 8.5 extracted a 9x9 MEPS grid surrounding Nuolja but collapsed it into 14 scalar tabular summary statistics (means, stds, upwind advection projections) fed to a tabular HistGradientBoostingRegressor.

stage8_17a.description: Stage 8.17A extracted point features at a single nearest grid cell (68.364774°N, 18.715312°E) and added 3 scalar disagreement features to the 37 baseline tabular features.

task5_stage8_forensic_check.forensic_conclusion: POLARIS has NEVER evaluated a raw 2D spatial field tensor or a spatial representation learning model.
